items.title: Should Cautious Guidance Require Action From Lam Research (LRCX) Investors?
items.summary: Lam Research reported first quarter 2027 revenue of US$8.22b and net income of US$2.75b, alongside guidance for December quarter revenue around US$8.6b and earnings per diluted share near US$2.33. Management paired record quarterly performance with commentary on component shortages and an expected near term drop in China related revenue, placing greater emphasis on execution and supply continuity rather than on demand alone. items.title: Tesla, Amazon, and SpaceX among companies snubbing tokenized stocks
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how Tesla (TSLA), Amazon (AMZN), SpaceX (SPCX), Netflix (NFLX), Lam Research (LRCX) and SoFi (SOFI) have opted out of a tokenized-stock offering, and why Nasdaq (^IXIC) sees tokenization as competition. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Lam Research Lost 34% in a Month. Bernstein Sees 53% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLam Research stock is down 34% in the past month. A record September quarter came with a December-quarter guide only in line with estimates, and fears about AI spending hit Applied Materials and the rest of the chip-equipment group too.

items.title: Applied Materials Just Dropped 29% In a Month: Will November 12 Earnings Rescue or Break AMAT Stock?
items.summary: Applied Materials has shed nearly a third of its value in a single month, and the chip equipment giant's November 12 earnings report now stands as either the catalyst for a recovery or proof the selloff has further to run.
